scripts.title: Autofarm
scripts.script:
-- this was made using remote spy
-- SELECT IF YOU WANT AUTOREBIRTH OR NOT, ITS ON BY DEFAULT
-- IF YOU WANT TO DEACTIVATE THE SCRIPT JUST REJOIN

auto_rebirth == true

while true do
    -- this tells the server we dropped a ball
    local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.DropBall
    Event:FireServer(
        {
        --  these vales are the value of the balls,
        --  i didnt understand how this worked but doesnt
        --  matter cuz they all guve the same exp
            m = 1,
            e = 1
        }
    )
    -- this tells the server the ball we dropped falled on the x10 box
    local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.BallLanded
    Event:FireServer(
        11
    )
    if auto_rebirth == true do
        -- this lets us rebirth instantly by adding it to the loop
        local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Rebirth
        Event:FireServer()
    end
    -- we wait so we dont explode()
    Wait(0.001)
end
